page0.text:
It is a silent night.
The wind blowing through the mountain forest is gentle, and the rustling of the trees is as faint as a whisper.
There are no birds singing about winter or beasts howling at the moon.
There is only one passage that leads to the Ryudou Temple.
The long stone stairs remain peaceful tonight as well.

page1.text:
But others do not know.
This place has already withstood five wars, each one a fight to the death.
Many Servants have challenged the Ryudou Temple.
Berserker, Lancer, Rider, Saber, and Archer.
The mountain is able to calmly enjoy the darkness thanks to the sorcerer that completely drove those five away.

page2.text:
The longsword moves.
Fortunately, it was a moonless night.
The crescent-shaped arc of the the moving sword is so elegant that the moon would be ashamed of itself if it saw it.

page3.text:
"Are you listening, Assassin? I told you that you will continue guarding the gate."
He ignores the purple mage, Caster.
Assassin lowers his longsword and glances at the forest without interest.
"Well, there was an intruder. I saw a strange bird so I tried slashing at it, but it did not bleed nor scream. Is this one of yours, Caster?"

page4.text:
"Oh...! ...Yes, this must have been a familiar spying on us. It must be Berserker's Master or that young lady. Either way, this place will not last for long."
Caster walks to the forest and looks down at the thing fallen on the ground.
It is the corpse of an owl.
A bird made out of crystal. A simple, yet excellent spying creation probably made by Archer's Master.

page5.text:
"...Heh. That young lady has no luck. I could have made her my student if she was a bit more incompetent."
She steps on it.
The amethyst crystals are crushed to pieces and scattered on the ground, shining like stars.

page6.text:
"There are many fellows like this, so I will leave you in charge of guarding my Master, Assassin. I will disappear if my Master dies. If that happens, you cannot exist either.
If you do not want to disappear, protect this gate with your life."

page7.text:
"Well... It is difficult to protect it with my life. I have never felt like I was 'alive' ever since I was born.
Is it not meaningless to order such a thing from one such as I?"
"...Stop your impudent talk.
Do not misunderstand, Assassin. You are a Servant I summoned. A Servant should act like a slave.
Look, if you cannot swear your loyalty to your Master, you can disappear right now."

page8.text:
There is only enmity and contempt in Caster's voice.
To her, Assassin is only a tool.
It is annoying enough for a tool to be talking, so it is natural for her to get irritated when it starts talking sarcastically.

page9.text:
"I see, good heavens. My life is like a mayfly, but it would be troublesome if I disappeared now. I have made a promise. If I can, I would like to fulfill this promise."
"...Then watch what you say. You only need to protect this place.
Yes, in the event that you are able to do so, I can make you real. If a low-class like you without a Noble Phantasm can become a Heroic Spirit, then it should be worth risking your life, right?"

page10.text:
"You do not need to worry. I have belonged to the other world from the beginning, so I shall carry out the role that has been given to me.
But, is it all right, Caster? I am not loyal to my Master either, but are you not being dishonest as well? Tonight's matter is a secret from your Master, correct?"
At that instant, Assassin's body explodes.
An explosive sound.
The curse Caster implanted into his body when he was summoned has exploded.

page11.text:
The trees sway.
Assassin is blown away and slammed into the forest, his chest pierced by his own ribs.
His figure looks like a blooming flower.

page12.text:
"Guh... This again. You are getting worse by the day, Caster."
"...Quiet. If I have to tell you one more time, I will eliminate you before waiting five days."
"...Geez. They say that women and immoral people are unmanageable, but you have gone too far."

page13.text:
The flashy Servant stands up slowly.
Even though his ribs are coming out of his chest and he's bloody all over, this Servant does not lose his elegance.

page14.text:
"Oh, do not glare at me with those eyes. Your beautiful face is ruined, Caster. I know, everything is to be a secret from your Master, right? I will hide the fact that you have captured Saber and that you have me as a guard.
It is a moving story. I hope that your caring spirit towards your Master reaches him."
"...Assassin, you..."

page15.text:
"What, I am just being a sore loser. I cannot attack you, so at least allow me to joke around like that.
...I will protect the gate. I shall protect it no matter what.
But, where are you going to go? Do you not trust my protection?"

page16.text:
"...Of course not. You are just insurance.
But, that is over. Once I get hold of Saber, I won't need to make this rustic place my temple."
"...Hm, so you will relocate? In that case, I certainly am not needed. Is there a sacred place superior to this mountain?"
"Yes. It is slightly inferior, but I have a place that suits me. Besides... I will be going there sooner or later anyways. There is no problem if I go there now, right?"

page17.text:
...
Assassin's expression, which has been cool throughout, clouds up.
Caster must have been satisfied to see that, as her glossy lips smile.

page18.text:
"I see. Our victory is certain, so I am going to go get my prize ahead of time.
A new territory and the Holy Grail. I even have another piece called Saber now. With this, I am sure my reluctant Master won't complain about my policy, right?"

page19.text:
That is true.
No matter how much Caster's Master, Souichirou Kuzuki, wants to stay silent, he will have no choice but to fight if the conditions line up so perfectly.
But, what is more certain than that is...

page20.text:
"...This silly battle will be over. There is nothing to fear once I obtain the Holy Grail.
...Yes, no one will be able to stop me, no matter who they are...!"

page21.text:
Her loud laughter soils the night.
The purple mage expresses her victory proudly.
The swordsman with the longsword gives her a side glance and looks up at the sky.
